leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: The Building Blocks of English
leadIn.content: Every English sentence is built from basic word classes: nouns for things, verbs for actions, and adjectives for descriptions.

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using The Building Blocks of English?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context
To translate sentences word-for-word from another language
It is an obsolete form never used by native speakers
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · This structure provides explicit grammatical function and clarity.

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of The Building Blocks of English require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English
Yes, matching grammatical forms ensures natural, accurate communication
Agreement only matters in formal academic writing
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: The Building Blocks of English
form.content: Subject + Verb + Object (e.g. The girl [subject] reads [verb] a book [object]).
